Select exact IC50 activities for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Left join docs on assays.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id and doi. Filter by target CHEMBL5251, standard_type IC50, and standard_relation '='. Return all requested columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows (do not deduplicate). Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
